score_breakdown.technical_62: robots+sitemap good; grade-D security headers; 307 not 301 for http→https; internal 308 chains; soft-404 reuses homepage meta; no confirmed canonical/viewport/robots-meta; trailing-slash 308s
score_breakdown.content_74: strong unique copy on hub/product pages; 152 blog + 25 news; llms.txt excellent; but blog/news duplicate post, service-area template bugs (wrong city in meta), contradictory delivery-time and service-model claims, award-year math error
score_breakdown.onpage_70: unique titles/descriptions on sampled pages; good H1 topic match; but fit-text H1 extraction risk, sitewide og:image, keyword-stuffed H1 on rates page, internal links to 308-redirected URLs
score_breakdown.schema_35: Service JSON-LD only on /residential-solutions; homepage/questions/service-areas/blog/portable-storage all null; LocalBusiness appears only in Google index snippet for service-areas (not confirmed in live HTML); no FAQPage, Article, Review, Breadcrumb
score_breakdown.performance_68: Framer SSG+edge cache, brotli, HTTP/2+h3, server-timing cached; HTML 43–70KB; but large inline font-face CSS (many families), Hotjar+GA, no Lighthouse/CWV lab data available
score_breakdown.ai_search_72: llms.txt present and comprehensive; llms-full.txt 404; robots allows all AI crawlers; but inconsistent NAP/phone facts and missing schema hurt extractability
score_breakdown.images_70: webp on content images, width/height present, framerusercontent CDN, descriptive alts on editorial images; sitewide og:image 1200x630 PNG 209KB, some icon alts generic
